title.suggested: Court rules on a bet over a proposed Allen-Gallagher fight

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that John Williams sued stakeholders Tom Kehoe and Mike McCoole for $30 bet on a proposed 1869 Allen-Gallagher fight that never came off. The court ruled it a forfeit, not a bet, and found for the defendants.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, February 24, 1870. Case tried the day before in Circuit Court No. 2 (Judge Knight).

facts.fact: Around February 25, 1869, a further fight between Allen and Charley Gallagher was in contemplation; Allen and Pendergast brought $1,000 in $20 gold pieces to McCoole's saloon to back it, but the match did not come off
John Williams sued stakeholders Tom Kehoe and Mike McCoole over a $30 wager on the proposed Allen-Gallagher fight; Circuit Court No. 2 ruled for the defendants

notes: Allen was not a party to the suit. The fight referred to is presumably a proposed rematch after the 1869-02-23 Allen-Gallagher fight; the article only says it did not come off.
